versions.subject: feat: new rules related to snake malware
versions.detection:
selection:
    Provider_Name: 'Service Control Manager'
    EventID: 7045
    ServiceName|contains: 'WerFaultSvc' # Note: The report contains a "," in the name ("WerFaultSvc,"). Since we can't confirm if its a typo or not we don't use it
    ImagePath|startswith: 'C:\Windows\WinSxS\'
    ImagePath|endswith: '\WerFault.exe'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Provider_Name="Service Control Manager" EventID=7045 ServiceName="*WerFaultSvc*" ImagePath="C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*" ImagePath="*\\WerFault.exe"
